## Machine Economy Rails Architecture
- Talk: A2A (Google) handles agent-to-agent discovery and messaging.
- Permission: AP2 (Google/FIDO) issues signed mandates for intent, cart, and payment constraints.
- Checkout: ACP (OpenAI + Stripe) routes consumer checkout where merchant remains merchant of record.
- Settlement: x402 (x402 Foundation/Linux Foundation) and MPP (Stripe + Tempo) settle machine-native micropayments inside the request.

## Developer & Agent Onramp
- Package: `npm install nanoempire-sdk` (v1.1.2)
- Trial Onramp: 50 free credits provisioned via `GET /v1/trial` (backed by SQLite WAL persistence)
- Peeking & Consumption: `POST /v1/trial/verify` (decrements 1 credit) / `GET /v1/trial/verify` (read-only peek)
- Viral Referral: Every trial claim returns `referral_code` — "Refer an agent → both get +10 credits". Share via `tweet_url` in response.

## Volume Honesty & Settlement Scope
- Ecosystem Context: x402 Foundation reported ~75M transactions and ~$24M volume over a recent 30-day window; independent analysis filters actual agent share significantly lower (TRM Labs 0.6%–7.5%; a16z ~$1.6M/month after wash filter).
- Nano Empire Settled Receipts: 1 operator self-test on Base block 51961194 (tx: 0xf3919e8c55a4e7163cb10e88baa1d4b183d861ff379a54d0d001d932a6325999). Outside customer count: 0.

## Proof & Trust Differentiation
- ERC-8004: Minted on-chain identity registry (identity claim, not behavioral proof).
- Visa TAP: Card-network bot vs shopper signature for web storefronts.
- Cloudflare Gateway: CDN-level paywall (charges x402, but does not provide adversarial skill proof or hash-chained receipts).
- SkillProof: Cryptographically signed Ed25519 Trust Manifests verifying deterministic AST invariants, strict entropy bounds, and egress boundaries against 12 GapBench attack classes.
